programme.title: Polar Worlds with Bertie Gregory Mashup
programme.desc: Traveler and filmmaker Bertie Gregory journeys to the poles to film wildlife in two of the harshest environments on the planet: the island of South Georgia in Antarctica and the frigid North Canada in the Arctic.You will see how the animals that inhabit these harsh areas cope and how global warming affects their habitats.You will see scenes from the lives of king and golden-crested penguins, sea lions, southern whales and petrels, as well as polar bears and wolves.Surviving in these extremely different environments requires cunning and perseverance.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: There is a constant struggle in the animal kingdom.Lions, elephants, polar bears and cobras engage in deadly fights.The cameras capture scenes full of tension, drama and determination.Each fight has a story behind it.An alligator boldly wanting to assert its dominance, a hungry bear fighting for food, or a fox taking part in a mating ritual - they will show their capabilities.Unique recordings show the colorful and cruel world of animals.Tactics, hidden weapons, deception - wild creatures use all possibilities and will stop at nothing to survive.

programme.title: Wild Hawaii
programme.desc: Hawaii was formed seven million years ago when it emerged from the sea.Initially, it was a volcanic wasteland, now it is considered an earthly paradise.Such a change is contrary to the laws of nature, and yet Hawaii is a wild Arcadia that is constantly transformed and influenced by numerous influences.Thanks to factors such as separation from the mainland, differences in altitude and tropical climate, the islands have developed an extremely rich flora and fauna, including species threatened with extinction;in fact, there are most of them here.

programme.title: Yellowstone Wolf Dynasty

programme.title: China's Wild Empire
programme.desc: China, one of the most populous countries in the world, is also the country with the highest biodiversity in the world outside the tropics.Dense forests, steep mountains, swamps and deserts are conditions conducive to the development of amazing animal species.The creators go to unknown places in China to see the richness of nature in this region of the Earth.They will learn about, among others, golden roxelans.These animals fight for food, mates and position in the herd.To survive, they face challenges such as weather, lack of food and the threat of predators.

programme.title: Incredible Animal Journeys
programme.desc: The authors of the six-episode series recorded the migrations of wild inhabitants of various corners of the globe, who cover huge distances in search of food, shelter or a partner to extend the continuity of the species.Animals travel hundreds of kilometers along centuries-old routes, using the Earth's magnetic field, stars, the Moon, ocean currents and natural senses on land and in the sea.Most of them go on amazing journeys many times during their lives.However, the biggest challenge is the first expedition, which is the most dangerous for inexperienced people.Jeremy Renner will talk about this unique adventure.Viewers will have the chance to see the majestic processions of zebras, whose migrations are considered one of the largest land migrations on the Blue Planet.Breathtaking photos will also allow you to admire elephants trying to find water during the drought disaster Over the course of several seasons, the film crew recorded migrations of wild inhabitants from various corners of the globe, who cover huge distances in search of food, shelter, water or a partner to extend the continuity of the species.Animals often travel hundreds of kilometers along routes known for centuries, using the Earth's magnetic field, stars, the Moon, ocean currents and natural senses.They wander over land, flow through vast oceans, long rivers and cover endless air spaces. Most of them make these exciting journeys many times during their lives.The most difficult first time The greatest challenge is the first expedition, which is full of many unpleasant surprises for inexperienced people.It happens that it is also the last one for them.A real school of life awaits novices.In the first episode, we will learn about the fate of a zebra foal taking its first steps to take part in the largest land migration of animals on the Blue Planet.Breathtaking photos will also show elephants trying to find water during a drought.The smallest of them are most at risk of dehydration, but the adults, led by the experienced grandmother elephant, do everything to ensure that the little ones survive the endless journey through the sun-burnt savannah.
